Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains two distinct MS approaches: 1) A large-scale SILAC-based AP-MS to identify interactomes of NAF1, NHP2, SHQ1, and GAR1, and 2) A targeted PTM analysis of purified GAR1 to map arginine methylations using chymotrypsin digestion and specific variable modifications (mono-, di-, and tri-methylation). The base workflow is DDA-SILAC, and the modifier is AP-MS.
